name: Jakkur
tagline: A northern neighbourhood with a lake at its heart.
description: Jakkur’s identity includes Jakkur Lake, the surrounding residential neighbourhoods and links towards Yelahanka and the northern road network. The Shivanahalli side includes homes around The HDFC School. Lake access, outlook and local road conditions vary by address and should not be inferred from the Jakkur label alone.

faqs.question: How would Aaramv compare homes here?
faqs.answer: We would compare Jakkur through the streets your family will use: the school run, daily shopping and the route to work. Where a home is sold on a lake outlook, we would ask to see that view from the actual unit. A neighbourhood landmark is valuable context; it is not a promise attached to every apartment.
